summary.text: Shaun Scott is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 43-Position 2 (Seattle), where he has served since January 2025, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Outside the Legislature he is a filmmaker, union organizer and author.

paragraphs.text: Shaun Scott studied history at the University of Washington and lives in Seattle's University District.
He is a filmmaker, a union organizer and the author of the book "Heartbreak City: Seattle Sports and the Unmet Promise of Urban Progress."

He has been a member of the Seattle Democratic Socialists of America since 2017, and the House Democrats' biography describes him as the first socialist elected to the Washington State Legislature since 1912.
Scott took office on January 13, 2025, succeeding Frank Chopp.
He is Vice Chair of the Labor & Workplace Standards Committee and sits on the Education and Finance committees.
